criteria.name: ML Model Development
criteria.guidance: Implement appropriate tree-based and boosting regression models with consistent preprocessing and reproducible settings.

criteria.name: Hyperparameter Tuning & Validation
criteria.guidance: Tune selected parameters using training-only cross-validation or a suitable validation split; keep final test data untouched.

criteria.name: Model Comparison & Performance Evaluation
criteria.guidance: Compare candidates on the same holdout using MAE, RMSE and R²; discuss practical differences and errors.

criteria.name: Risk Factor / Feature Importance Analysis
criteria.guidance: Use valid model or permutation importance to interpret purchase drivers; distinguish association from causation.

criteria.name: Clustering & Customer Segmentation
criteria.guidance: Aggregate purchase behaviour at customer level, scale appropriate features, assess cluster quality and explain segments with evidence.
